Title: Service program writable by users
Detail: C:\ProgramData\Vendor\agent.exe, runs as LocalSystem (Running): writable by Authenticated Users on the file (Modify, Synchronize); BUILTIN\Users on the folder (Write). It starts at boot.
Attacks: Privilege escalation: a user replaces the service program (or plants a DLL it loads) and the code runs with the service's account, often SYSTEM, at the next start.

Title: Service program writable by users
Detail: C:\Tools\PrintHelper\helper.exe, runs as LocalSystem (Stopped): writable by BUILTIN\Users on the folder (AppendData, Synchronize).
